hook_text: Your milk, your eggs and your school shoes may all have come from farm animals.
clip_script: The KwaZulu-Natal Midlands at sunrise. Black-and-white dairy cows walk slowly into the milking shed. On the green hill behind them, Nguni cattle with patterned hides graze. Goats nibble bushes near the fence, and chickens scratch in the yard. Large stock, small stock and poultry, all on one farm. Milk, beef, leather, eggs and meat, all from animals that need grass, water, shelter and care every single day.
visual_style: Whiteboard farm with three labelled groups: a cow, then a sheep, goat and pig, then a chicken, each with arrows to the products it gives.
mood: Warm and busy, like early morning on a farm.
pacing: Quick introductions to each animal, then a fast list of products.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list everything in your kitchen that came from a farm animal.
